description.narrative: Engro Fertilizers Limited (Company), incorporated in Pakistan and a manufacturer and distributor of fertilizers, is seeking a general-purpose corporate loan in local currency. IFC has been invited to arrange a financing package comprising of a Partial Credit Guarantee (PCG), to be issued by IFC in favor of a commercial bank, which is providing a local currency loan to Engro Fertilizers (Project). In addition, the Project is supported by the IFC-Canada Facility for Resilient Food Systems (FRFS) to de-risk the investment.

The most significant expected project-level outcomes are i) stakeholder effects by expanding fertilizer access through a direct distribution model complemented by digital solutions and the provision of technical assistance; and ii) economy-wide effects by sustaining value addition and employment through facilities turnaround. Beyond the Project, IFC expects the Project to strengthen sector resilience by demonstrating the impact of digital technologies and direct-to-farmer approaches in improving efficiency, transparency, and farmer engagement.
